One Teacher's Engagement Strategies for High School Students

Reflect on engagement tools that promote emotional awareness and inclusive classroom participation.

A high school teacher shares classroom engagement strategies including mood check-ins and student response cards. These methods help build inclusion, emotional awareness, and student participation by giving learners multiple ways to express themselves. The teacher emphasizes empathy, safety, and peer connection.
